title: GenerationResult
description: A filled GenerationRequest: the artifact a filler (human skill or AI) produced for a request, plus how it was filled. The engine applies it through the canonical write op for the request's kind; the artifact content satisfies the request's `produces` contract. Strict at the top level: unknown fields are errors.

artifact.description: The content satisfying the request's `produces` contract (e.g. the finding fields, the decision rationale, the study spec).

status.description: The filler's self-report; the apply step sets the authoritative outcome.

applied_to.description: The fields/files the apply step wrote (for audit + undo).
